titre: the note-taking method each subject actually needs #studytok #studytips #school #studymethod
notes: Schéma methods-per-subject (@studyy.hackz : 384 k le 10/10, 615 k le 06/10, valable jusqu'au 9/11). Autre plainte que cs-o001, cs-o003 et cs-o005 : « “my notes are useless when it's time to study” » (retenue : la plainte entre guillemets, et un angle neuf, la prise de notes par matière), « “I take notes but never look at them again” » (écartée : moins précise), « “I copy the whole slide and learn nothing” » (écartée : pas une plainte de toutes les élèves). Six méthodes de prise de notes, aucune déjà prise : Cornell (méthode reconnue), le cahier exemple / essai pour les maths, deux colonnes pour le vocabulaire (place micabo, slide 5), le schéma de processus, la banque de citations, le téléphone dans le sac pendant le cours (place UnSwipe, slide 8). Images jamais prises par nos originaux, sans visage ; slides 5 et 8 sans personne. Écartée à l'aperçu : 11b6d69f (marque possible sur la trousse).

slides.texte_overlay:
“my notes are useless
when it's time to study”

same, until I changed HOW I take them.
here's the method for each subject...

Cornell notes 📝
Best for: History, Biology, Economics
notes on the right, key questions on the left, a 2-line summary at the bottom. later you cover the right side and answer.

Example / your turn ➗
Best for: Maths, Physics, Chemistry
left page: the example from class. right page: a similar problem you solve yourself.

Two columns 🔤
Best for: Languages, definitions
word on the left, meaning on the right. fold the page and test yourself on one side.

Process diagrams 🔁
Best for: Biology, Chemistry, Geography
turn every process into arrows and boxes: each step, what causes the next one.

Quote bank 📚
Best for: Literature, Philosophy
one page per theme with 4 or 5 short quotes you can use in any essay.

Phone in your bag 📵
Best for: every class
you can't take good notes while checking notifications. it stays in your bag until the bell.
